name: TAROK SLOVENIAN
description: Slovenian Tarok is the most popular parlour game in Slovenia, a point trick-taking game with bidding closely related to Austrian Tarock. 54 cards: 8 per suit (Clubs, Spades, Hearts, Diamonds) plus 22 trumps (taroks). Highest trump Å kis, then Mond (XXI), lowest trump (I). Black suits K-Q-Knight-J-10-9-8-7; red K-Q-Knight-J-1-2-3-4. Kings, Å kis, Mond, lowest trump 5 pts each; Queens 4, Knights 3, Jacks 2, others 1. Four players; dealer gives 12 cards each in two batches of 6 (counter-clockwise), 6 in talon. Bidding from Three up to Valat Without. With three/two/one declarer calls a King for secret partner. Declarer's side wins by taking more than half the card points.

Most popular parlour game in Slovenia; closely related to Austrian KÃ¶nigrufen. 54-card pack, 4 players, bidding and calling a King; declarer's side aims for majority of card points.
Four players. The four-player version is the most popular form for social play; one player is dealer, and partnerships are determined by bidding and by calling a King in three, two, or one contracts.
First 6 cards to talon; then 12 cards each in two batches of 6, counter-clockwise starting to dealer's right.

items.text: Calling a king or trula: If declarer holds all four kings in three/two/one, some allow calling a trula card instead; if holding all kings and all trula, some allow calling a trump.
Piccolo: Optional negative contract: win exactly one trick. Worth 70. Ranks between solo one and beggar. Not all circles allow it.
